core_obligations: Reduce to the composite (proof lines 613-627): the construction sends identities to identities by the earlier verification, so it remains to show that the correspondence of a composite morphism is the composite of the correspondences; as in the construction of the category of correspondences it suffices, for integral schemes, to prove the displayed equality of cycles involving the intersection product of the two pulled back graphs.

Identify the triple graph (proof lines 627-642): the image of the closed immersion of the third scheme into the triple product is scheme theoretically the intersection of the graphs of the two morphisms in the triple product, so its class is the intersection product appearing in the displayed equality; pushing forward along the projection to the outer product gives the graph of the composite, which proves the equality.
proof_roadmap: Use the known behaviour on identities.
Reduce functoriality to an equality of intersection products.
Identify the triple graph with the intersection and push it forward.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that sending a smooth projective scheme to itself and a morphism to the class of its graph defines a contravariant functor to the category of correspondences (statement lines 609-614). The proof (proof lines 615-642) reduces functoriality to an equality of intersection products and identifies the graph of a composite with the pushforward of the intersection of the two graphs. H2: a complete short argument in two steps.
